usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the RPN calculator in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj build` and gives the expected output on both examples. I also ran `-7 2 /`, which gave `-3`, so division truncates toward zero. I didn't test any other inputs.

It reads each line, skips blank lines, and evaluates left to right. It stops at the first error on a line. A lone `-` is treated as the subtract operator, and `-5` as a negative
